name: More Wastewander Justice
summary: East and southeast of Gadgetzan, Bilgewhizzle now targets Wastewander rogues, assassins, and shadow mages. With fewer nomads left, the company can more easily reclaim the water wells.

sections.title: The Stronger Ranks
sections.body: Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle says you have done well, but the company needs fewer nomads before it can reclaim the wells. Now you face their rogues, assassins, and shadow mages east and southeast of Gadgetzan. Bilgewhizzle calls them a nasty lot. He insists the wells rightfully belong to the company.

sections.title: Taking the Fight to Them
sections.body: With the nomad population thinned, the company can take the fight to them. Bilgewhizzle points you to Spigot Operator Luglunket in Gadgetzan. Luglunket offers a bounty for any Wastewander water pouches you collected while dealing with the nomads.

faq.answer: Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle of the Gadgetzan Water Company asks you in Gadgetzan.

faq.q: Why does the Gadgetzan Water Company want these nomads removed?
faq.answer: The company wants to reclaim the water wells, and fewer nomads will make that easier.

faq.q: Where can the targeted nomads be found?
faq.answer: The targeted nomads are east and southeast of Gadgetzan.
